title: Hatsune Miku — A Guiding Song〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Between Worlds

rows.Speaker: Mametchi
rows.Line: That was my rendition of the song we've been assigned. How was it?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Nothing felt off with the tempo or the pitch, so I'd say you did a really good job.

rows.Speaker: Mametchi
rows.Line: Really? What a relief...! I was a bit worried whether I'd be able to sing it without the sheet music.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Were you still in the middle of learning it?

rows.Speaker: Mametchi
rows.Line: No, I have it memorized. It's just that my sheet music has notes about the dynamics, when to take breaths and so on.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, I see...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Mametchi's singing felt a little stiff at some parts, but is that because...?)
se_walk_women_001_4
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Thanks for waiting, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What'd you call us over for in such a hu—

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hold on, who are you?!

rows.Speaker: Mametchi
rows.Line: P-Pleased to meet you! I'm Mametchi!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What's going on here, Miku...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Um, let me start from the beginning.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Whaaat?! You're from a different planet?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I wanna hear more about that sleep-learning machine! It sounds cool!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Settle down, you two. Can't you tell you're making things harder for Mametchi?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I mean, every single thing we just heard was shocking.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, it certainly was an incredible story.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I was stunned by the idea to improve your singing by using a special machine to learn in your sleep...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And it was a real shock to find out that you ended up here before you knew it, all because you heard Miku's singing instead of the song you've been assigned.

rows.Speaker: Mametchi
rows.Line: Yes... It's all a huge surprise to me too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: As for what I called you all about... Mametchi's friends might've been brought here too.

rows.Speaker: Mametchi
rows.Line: Their names are Kuchipatchi, Memetchi and Mimitchi, and I believe they've all used my sleep-learning machine.

rows.Speaker: Mametchi
rows.Line: I was lucky enough to come across Miku...

rows.Speaker: Mametchi
rows.Line: But the rest of them may be feeling lost and alone right now.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That would be terrible...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They may have ended up in SEKAI, so I think we're the only ones who'll be able to find them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's why I was hoping you could all help look.

rows.Speaker: Mametchi
rows.Line:
All three of them are my treasured tama friends!
Please, help us!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Don't you worry, Mametchi. When it comes to SEKAI stuff, we're the experts!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! We'll find your friends for you!

rows.Speaker: Mametchi
rows.Line: Th-Thank you...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Alright, let's get right to our—

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hold on, Len. We won't know what to look for if we don't know anything about them.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It would be helpful to see a photo or something to know what they look like...

rows.Speaker: Mametchi
rows.Line: Um... I don't have any photos, but I may be able to draw portraits for you all.

rows.Speaker: Mametchi
rows.Line: Oh, good. I still have my trusty pen and notebook.

rows.Speaker: Mametchi
rows.Line: Okay... Let me give this a try!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: This little one's pulling some remarkable faces...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes... Something tells me drawing might not be...

rows.Speaker: Mametchi
rows.Line:
Huff... Huff...
F-Finished...

rows.Speaker: Mametchi
rows.Line:
I'll start with Mimitchi.
As you can see, Mimitchi's ears are similar to mine, but slightly longer!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Umm... I guess the round part is the body? But... Where are the ears...?)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (If their ears are supposed to be similar, then they're probably that part colored in all black...right?)

rows.Speaker: Mametchi
rows.Line: As for Kuchipatchi, you'll be looking for someone green, and with a notably large mouth!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (The eyes are in quite a unique position... Oh, is this portrait drawn in profile?)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (By “large mouth”, do you mean the beak jutting out from the side? Though there aren't any wings, so it seems Kuchipatchi isn't a bird...)

rows.Speaker: Mametchi
rows.Line: And this is Memetchi, who has distinctive curly hair and sparkly eyes!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (C-Curly hair...? Is that what that spiral on top is?)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (What are those lines coming out of the eyes? Maybe eyelashes? But no, they're perfectly straight, and they seem too long to be...)

rows.Speaker: Mametchi
rows.Line: Will these help...?

rows.Speaker: Mametchi
rows.Line: I think I managed to capture their defining features, but I'm not the best at drawing...

rows.Speaker: Miku & Co.
rows.Line: (I had a feeling...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Even then, you did your very best to draw them for us.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (You must be so worried about your friends...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Don't worry, Mametchi! We should know what to look for now that we've seen these!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Right. And when we do find your friends, these will be a good way to show that you sent us.

rows.Speaker: Mametchi
rows.Line: All of you...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Now, let's officially start our search for Mametchi's friends.

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You stay here with Mametchi, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Good luck!
se_walk_men_001_2
se_walk_women_001_4

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They're sure to find which SEKAI your friends ended up in, Mametchi.

rows.Speaker: Mametchi
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Mametchi
rows.Line: Um, Miku! Is there nothing for me to do?

rows.Speaker: Mametchi
rows.Line: I may only be a hindrance to you all, but Kuchipatchi and the others are my tama friends!

rows.Speaker: Mametchi
rows.Line: So, I...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Mametchi...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Why don't you practice singing here with me, Mametchi?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm sure that'll help you find your friends.

rows.Speaker: Mametchi
rows.Line: Huh?
